mapper.select: SELECT material_check_ms, simulate_generate_ms, result_finalize_ms, fail_stage FROM sim_config WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sim_config (id, material_check_ms, simulate_generate_ms, result_finalize_ms, fail_stage, updated_at) VALUES (1, #{materialCheckMs}, #{simulateGenerateMs}, #{resultFinalizeMs}, #{failStage}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE material_check_ms = VALUES(material_check_ms), simulate_generate_ms = VALUES(simulate_generate_ms), result_finalize_ms = VALUES(result_finalize_ms), fail_stage = VALUES(fail_stage), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
